title: Dolly Parton Honored at Grand Ole Opry Tribute With Carly Pearce, Jelly Roll & More
summary: The Nashville landmark dedicated its Saturday night show to celebrating the life and legacy of the late country icon.
body: The Grand Ole Opry is remembering Dolly Parton . On Saturday (Aug. 29), the Nashville landmark brought together Carly Pearce , Jelly Roll and a host of other artists to celebrate the life and legacy of the late country icon. Related Kacey Musgraves Pays Tribute to Dolly Parton With ‘Rainbow’ & ‘Here You Come Again’ Live in Boston Nashville Airport to Be Renamed for Dolly Parton, Tennessee Governor Announces Dolly Parton’s 25 Best Songs: Critics’ Picks “There are artists who make country music. And then there are artists who become part of its very heart. That’s Dolly Parton,” the Opry wrote on Instagram alongside photos from the concert. “Dolly, thank you for making the Opry, and country music, richer, brighter and unmistakably your own. You will forever be a cherished member of our Opry family.” The Opry dedicated its regularly scheduled Saturday night show to Parton, who was inducted into the legendary Nashville institution in 1969 and remained an Opry member for more than five decades. title: Every Song That Topped the U.K. Chart for 8 or More Weeks, But Didn’t Make the Top 10 on the Hot 100
summary: "Rein Me In” by Sam Fender and Olivia Dean is the first single to log 23 weeks at No. 1 in the U.K. It hasn't even made the top 40 on the Hot 100, but it's closing in.
body: UPDATE (Aug. 30): “Rein Me In” by Sam Fender and Olivia Dean logs its 23rd nonconsecutive week at No. 1 on the U.K.’s Official Singles Chart on the tally that was published on Friday (Aug. 28). The song hasn’t been nearly as big a hit in the U.S., though it isn’t done yet. It jumps from No. 50 to No. 45 in its 22nd week on the Billboard Hot 100 dated Aug. 29, its highest ranking to date. “Rein Me In” is the first single to log 23 weeks at No. 1 in the U.K., but it has yet to reach the top 10 (or even the top 40) on the Hot 100. In the 68 years that the Hot 100 has been in place, music fans in the U.S. and the U.K. have never been so far apart in their reactions to a song. Here’s an essay on how “Rein Me In” became the U.K.’s longest-running No. 1 single ever. And here’s a look at the song that previously held the record, Frankie Laine ‘s “I Believe.” PREVIOUSLY (April 23): Music fans in the United States and the United Kingdom often agree on big hits. title: Hearts2Hearts’ ‘ICONIC HEART’ Records Highest First-Week Sales Among 5th-Gen K-Pop Girl Group Japanese Debuts
summary: The title track "ICONIC HEART" also entered the Billboard Japan Hot 100 at No. 2.
body: Hearts2Hearts’ ICONIC HEART debuted at No. 2 on Billboard Japan’s weekly Top Singles Sales chart released Aug. 19 — tracking the week from Aug. 10 to 16 — with first-week sales of 65,176 copies. Hearts2Hearts is an eight-member K-pop girl group consisting of JIWOO, CARMEN, YUHA, STELLA, JUUN, A-NA, IAN and YE-ON. The group debuted in South Korea in February 2025 and swept nine rookie awards, making them the most-awarded rookie act among K-pop artists who debuted that year. ICONIC HEART , released Aug. 12, marks the group’s milestone Japanese debut single. It was issued in six formats — a regular edition, first press limited edition A with a photobook, first press limited edition B with member profile sheets, first press limited edition C with postcards, first press limited edition D with initial beads, and a UNIVERSAL MUSIC STORE exclusive edition — each containing three tracks including “RUDE! (Japanese Ver.).” The title track “ICONIC HEART” also entered the Billboard Japan Hot 100 at No. 2 on the chart released the same day for the same tracking period, while topping the radio airplay metric — a strong start for a debut single. title: Harry Styles Jokes About Taylor Swift’s MSG Wedding During Residency Show
summary: The singer name-checked the Knicks' championship and his ex's wedding in the same breath at his third Madison Square Garden date.
body: Harry Styles gave a cheeky nod to ex-girlfriend Taylor Swift’s wedding during night three of his Madison Square Garden residency on Saturday (Aug. 29). Toward the end of the set, he hyped up the venue’s recent history before pivoting to the joke: “We’re at Madison Square Garden, home of the world champion New York Knicks!” he told the crowd, before adding, “And they also do weddings.” The line, referencing Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce ‘s July 3 wedding at the arena, drew loud cheers. Styles and Swift dated from November 2012 to January 2013, a relationship widely understood to have inspired Swift’s 2014 hit “Style.” He reportedly received an invitation to the Swift-Kelce wedding but didn’t attend; sources told Variety at the time he was “currently on tour and will not make it to MSG.” His fiancée, Zoë Kravitz, went to the ceremony without him. body: 6 Min Read Grants The NSSC supports the Agency’s internal effort to create an environment conducive to streamlining and simplifying grants and cooperative agreements. The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), through the establishment of the NSSC, has transitioned to a consolidated model for the award and administration of all Agency grants and cooperative agreements. The consolidation is designed to achieve efficient and effective service, improve data quality, standardize processes, leverage skills and investments, and provide economies of scale. * Notice * The Payment Management System (PMS) is currently experiencing issues affecting Federal Financial Report (FFR) generation.
